title: ECCO2 Ocean Visualization Color Index
description: Exploratory color index extracted from NASA ECCO2 rendered ocean-current and temperature visualization. Not calibrated sea-surface temperature or current velocity.

source.organization: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / Scientific Visualization Studio
source.attribution: NASA/GSFC Scientific Visualization Studio; ECCO2 MIT/JPL model.
source.disclaimer: Visualization-derived ocean color index from rendered ECCO2 model imagery. Not calibrated sea-surface temperature, ocean-current speed, or a direct satellite measurement.

channels.name: Rendered Ocean Color Index
channels.description: Normalized hue index calculated from sufficiently saturated pixels in the rendered ECCO2 ocean visualization. Affected by flowline density and visualization styling; not a physical temperature measurement.

legend.pitch: Pitch represents the rendered ocean color index, not measured temperature or current speed.
legend.stereo: Horizontal image-grid position controls stereo panning.
legend.silence: Cells without sufficient qualifying colored pixels are silent; missing does not mean zero temperature.

processing.method: HSV hue from saturated rendered pixels; block averaging
limitations: Hue is circular and arithmetic averages may cross the hue seam.
Dark and gray ocean regions may be excluded.
Colored flowline density affects the output.
Grid cells are not independently georeferenced.
Differences do not represent physical temperature change.
